title: Utah moves to drop criminal pursuit of Kalshi after the firm halted services there
content: The state continues to hold the criminal charges in its back pocket with a vow to hit Kalshi and other prediction markets with gambling accusations if they return.

content: Monday's tech enthusiasm is quickly fading on Tuesday, while bitcoin remains near bear-market lows.

title: South Korea proposes ending 2017 ICO ban to boost jobs and onshore crypto investment
content: Token issuers would have to disclose how they plan to spend investors' money and could face criminal charges for misleading buyers.

title: Crypto trader Ansem says his wallet was hacked as $2 million in memecoins were sold
content: Ansem suspects someone broke into his account on Bullpen, the trading terminal he co-founded, where the wallet's private key had been imported.

title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
content: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.

title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years

title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
content: The US regulator has approved permanent reporting rules for certain event contracts as more companies look to launch prediction markets.

title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
content: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price

title: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing
content: The Ethereum Foundation has doubled its protocol security team and is prioritizing a cryptographic overhaul as advances in AI threaten the mathematical assumptions that keep billions in crypto safe.

title: Bitcoin Losses Are the Worst Since FTX. Is the Bottom Near?
content: Bitcoin slipped below $60,000 as realized losses nearly doubled in a week. Glassnode says the sell-off resembles past market bottoms, but another drop to $53,200 could be in the cards.

title: South Korea Moves to Lift Its ICO Ban After Nearly a Decade
content: The Financial Services Commission’s draft Digital Asset Act would let domestic projects sell tokens again under IPO-style disclosure rules, reversing a 2017 ban that mostly pushed Korean issuers offshore.
